issues.brief_report: Sessions subsystem and menu, not a durable MMO backend
issues.proposed_fix: Keep identity, inventories, regions, transfer and social records outside the session adapter.
issues.test: Admit a character only after the service issues a valid lease.

issues.proposed_fix: Inspect exact methods; implement a tested lifecycle or report unsupported operations.
issues.test: Call start twice and simulate provider failure; one terminal result per operation.

issues.brief_report: CreateSession reportedly continues after asynchronous DestroySession
issues.proposed_fix: Wait for successful destroy completion before creating. Serialize host operations; reset pending intent on every failure.
issues.test: Host with an existing session; delayed destroy must not overlap create.

issues.brief_report: Reported ?listen suffix and sample ThirdPersonCPP lobby
issues.proposed_fix: Use authored Briarwake maps for prototype; separate dedicated-server advertisement from local menu creation.
issues.test: A headless server starts without a local player or listen URL.

issues.proposed_fix: Travel only after successful join and a resolved valid destination. Recover join button on failure/no matches.
issues.test: Search returns zero, join fails, address is empty: no travel and usable retry UI.

issues.brief_report: Reported local player / network ID dereferences
issues.proposed_fix: Validate local objects on clients; use a distinct provider-supported dedicated identity/advertisement path.
issues.test: Run with no local player; no crash or forged client identity.

issues.proposed_fix: Audit Build.cs and .uplugin before a Null/LAN test; independently verify Steam configuration and dedicated support.
issues.test: Two external clients join the intended provider/session, not unrelated lobby results.

issues.brief_report: Repeated MenuSetup and callback teardown need inspection
issues.proposed_fix: Bind once per operation/lifecycle; clear delegate handles on completion/destruction. Recover every button/error state.
issues.test: Open/close the menu repeatedly while search is outstanding; no late call into destroyed UI.
